bio.2005.zh: 开局约360天后：异常波动（姊妹星系事件链）
bio.2005.en: About 360 days after start: Unusual Fluctuations (the sister-system chain)

bio.2015.zh: 击毁第一波生物舰队后：敌人的残骸
bio.2015.en: After destroying the first wave of bioships: Remains of the Enemy

bio.2025.zh: 研发虫洞科技后：敌人的摇篮
bio.2025.en: After researching the wormhole tech: Cradle of the Enemy

bio.2027.zh: 击毁弃置孵化场的防御后：恐惧的黄昏
bio.2027.en: After the abandoned hatchery defences fall: Twilight of Fear

bio.2036.zh: 再次击毁生物舰队后：它们在学习
bio.2036.en: After another bioship fleet is destroyed: They Learn

bio.2040.zh: 孵化场防御被击毁（非本起源）：敌人迷失
bio.2040.en: Hatchery defences destroyed (non-origin empires): Enemy Lost

opening.evidence: game_start: starlit_citadel_start_effect (common/scripted_effects/biogenesis_effects.txt:59) fires bio.2005 after 360+0-90 days; 2005 starts abandoned_hatchery_chain_1 and hidden 2010 (after 90+0-180 days), which spawns the bioship waves and repeats through 2035 every 1800+0-1800 days (events/biogenesis_origin_events.txt:1887-2000, :2343-2420). bio.2015 / 2036 on_fleet_destroyed_perp common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1686-1687; 2024 (on_tech_increased common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:2743) -> 2025; 2026 (on_ship_destroyed_perp :1477) -> 2027 (origin) or 2040.

label.en: After the hatchery defences are destroyed

note.en: Hidden 2026: the Starlit Citadel origin gets 2027 (1 day later), anyone else 2040 (events/biogenesis_origin_events.txt:2144-2214).
The Home of the Enemy project completes.

notes.zh: “兵临城下”事件链的第一部分；之后事件链2–4分别在残骸研究、虫洞科技与孵化场陷落时开启。生物舰队每1800±1800天再次入侵，数量逐次增加（隐藏 2035）。
notes.en: Starts the Siege of the Citadel chain (part 1); parts 2-4 start at the remains study, the wormhole tech and the hatchery fall. Bioship invasions recur every 1800+0-1800 days with growing numbers (hidden 2035).

uncertain: bio.2015 / 2036 are generic fleet-destroyed hooks gated by origin state inside the event; their exact conditions were read from the listing only.
